items.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Certain tunes of Burt Bacharach, “The Look of Love” and all that, we had to play that.

ctx.x: Well they’ve come a long way. But I have to jump on something you said because I want you to explain it. You said, “The kind of rock that jazz guys can play.”

Well you know, we didn’t know that many of the tunes. But the pop tunes had a rock influence. Certain tunes of Burt Bacharach, “The Look of Love” and all that, we had to play that. And we played “Sunny” and we played some blues and I guess we played, what was the one that they all did a drum solo on every time?
